name: Boss Uramon
description: A crime boss in Numai whose hitmen included Toshi, and who owned the Shadow Gate.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes through the Shadow Gate and barters with Night's Reach for teleportation power, kills Uramon, teleports Michiko to Pearl-Ear and mercy kills Choryu.
timeline.quote: Toshi also teleports to Hidetsugu's lair and mercy kills Choryu despite knowing it would enrage Hidetsugu.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu kills Boss Uramon's task force except Toshiro Umezawa, whom he agrees to form the Hyozan Reckoners with.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu killed all the men except Umezawa

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshiro Umezawa meets Kiku on his trek through Takenuma; she takes him to Uramon.
timeline.quote: Toshiro Umezawa met Kiku during his trek through Takenuma when going home from a soratami attack.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, sent with Uramon's hitmen to attack Hidetsugu, convinces the ogre to form the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: The ogre killed all the others, but the kanji mage managed to convince him to form an allegiance that became known as the Hyozan Reckoners

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer turn on Uramon; Toshi steals the Shadow Gate and is united with it by Night's Reach.
timeline.quote: When Uramon ordered Toshi's death, both of the new hyozan turned on their former lord.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: He kills her after following her to the Shadow Gate.
relations.quote: After killing Uramon, Kiku and Marrow go lie low.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Toshi was one of Uramon's hitmen.
relations.quote: Toshi became a member of Boss Uramon 's hitmen.
